Test Case: Push notification arrives 2 hours before the end of the order
Precondition: Courier is logged in, has an accepted (not completed) order with today's delivery date, emulator time can be changed
Test Steps: 1. Set emulator time to 9:59 p.m. on the delivery date. 2. Wait for the notification.
Expected Result: A push notification is received at 9:59 p.m. on the delivery date.
Actual Result: No push notification was received at 9:59 p.m . on the delivery date. The notification shade contained only system notifications (Virtual SD card, Serial console enabled). Checked again at 10:02 p.m., still no notification from the app.

Test Case: No push notification before the 2-hour mark
Test Steps: 1. Set emulator time to 9:58 p.m. on the delivery date. 2. Wait a minute and check the notification panel.
Actual Result: No push notification was received from the app. After setting the emulator time to 9:58 p.m. on the delivery date and waiting one minute, the notification panel contained only a system notification (“Serial console enabled”).

Test Steps: 1. Open the notification panel. 2. Read the notification text.
Expected Result: Text is: '2 hours to the end of the order. The order "<order address> " must be completed before time X. If you can't make it in time, alert support: 0101'. Order address and time are filled in correctly.
Actual Result: The notification text could not be verified because no push notification was received. The order was accepted after the emulator time was set to 9:50 p.m. on the delivery date , the app was left in the background and the notification panel was checked after 10:00 p.m. It contained only a system notification (“Serial console enabled”). This is caused by the bug reported for Test 1 (push notification not received).

Test Case: No Internet connection' pop-up on the login screen
Precondition: Login screen is open, Internet is turned off in the emulator
Expected Result: No Internet connection' pop-up with an 'Ok' button is displayed.
Actual Result: The “No Internet connection” pop-up with an “Ok” button is not displayed. After turning off the Internet in the emulator and tapping “Login”, only a technical toast message is shown at the bottom of the screen: Unable to resolve host “cnt-09ab4f72-8f3c-4e9c-8092-76bafb15d5ac. containerhub...”. The user is not informed in a user-friendly way.

Test Case: No Internet connection' pop-up on the order list screen
Precondition: Courier is logged in, order list is open, Internet is turned off
Test Steps: 1. Tap any active button (e.g. 'Accept' or 'My orders' tab).
Expected Result: No Internet connection' pop-up with an 'Ok' button is displayed.
Actual Result: After turning off the Internet and tapping the “My orders” tab, a pop-up is displayed: title “No Internet access”, text “Check the connection or wait for a notification that it has been restored” and an “OK” button.

Precondition: No Internet connection' pop-up is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Tap outside the pop-up. 2. Press the Android Back button.
Expected Result: Pop-up stays on the screen. It disappears only when 'Ok' is tapped.
Actual Result: After tapping outside the pop-up, the “No Internet access” pop-up closed without tapping the “OK” button. After pressing the Android Back button, the pop-up also closed without tapping the “OK” button.

Test Case: Pop-up repeats while there is no Internet
Precondition: No Internet connection' pop-up is displayed, Internet is still off
Test Steps: 1. Tap 'Ok'. 2. Tap any active button again.
Expected Result: Pop-up closes after 'Ok' and is displayed again after tapping an active button.
Actual Result: After tapping “OK”, the pop-up closed. When the “My orders” tab was tapped again while the Internet was still off, the “No Internet access” pop-up was displayed again.

Test Case: Pop-up closes when Internet is back
Precondition: No Internet connection' pop-up is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Turn Internet on. 2. Tap 'Ok'. 3. Tap an active button.
Expected Result: Pop-up closes and the app works normally, the pop-up does not appear again.
Actual Result: After turning the Internet back on, tapping “OK” closed the pop-up. Tapping the “My orders” tab afterwards worked normally: the tab opened and the “No Internet access” pop-up did not appear again.

Test Case: No Internet connection' pop-up layout matches design
Precondition: No Internet connection' pop-up is displayed
Expected Result: Pop-up layout, text and 'Ok' button match the design.
Actual Result: The pop-up layout, title (“No Internet access”) and text (“Check the connection or wait for a notification that it has been restored”) match the design. The button label does not match: the design shows “ok” in lowercase, the app shows “OK” in uppercase.
